4OhkEH-FDbk.d1: The metrotram – a hybrid transport network – runs in the city of Kryvyi Rih. The initial plan in the 1970s was to build an underground railway system. As a result of serious underfunding, this idea was not implemented; instead, trams were launched on the lines. The Kryvyi Rih metrotram has both overground and underground sections, and is a vital transport system for this sprawling, elongated industrial city.

ch: - Approaching of the Belgrade-Bar railway line (59:40),
Nbxot-F9FnU.d1: This video shows local passenger train cabview throughout middle Montenegro, from the mountains around Niksic, through Zeta river valley, to the plains around Podgorica. Train starts ride at large plateau. Not long after, the line enters the longest tunnel "Budos" (L = 1250m ) and the line suddenly change its character to mountainous. The first half of the route line has mountainous character. There are cliffs, tunnels and great railway descent. The line runs through 12 tunnels and few bridges and continuously descends towards Podgorica. Railway line Podgorica - Niksic descends from the 636m level to an altitude of 51m. To overcome the high altitude difference at a short distance, a serpentine was made between Slap and Danilovgrad. The second half of travel the railway line meanders through the valley of the Zeta river. After the city Danilovgrad railway line is located in the plain.

Fb84ur_wex8.d1: The masterpiece of engineering endeavour, this is how the famous Belgrade - Bar railway is briefly presented. This railway line initially has the characteristics of a plain and flat line, but shortly afterwards it turns into a distinctly mountainous railway line. In order to reach the sea, it was necessary to overcome several large mountain passes. The route runs through narrow and winding river canyons, crosses very deep and steep cliffs and has particularly large longitudinal gradients. Railway line Beograd - Bar is a special railway line, sustained by spectacular infrastructure facilities. On its way from Belgrade to Montenegro and the Adriatic Sea coast the line goes through 254 tunnels and 234 bridges.

Hn52-4xvZs4.t: Bulgarian railways cab ride 2024: Balkan crossing railway Stara Zagora - Gorna Oryahovitsa
Hn52-4xvZs4.d1: След 1900 г. Княжество България преживява остра финансова криза, която налага спиране на железопътното строителство. Когато към 1905 г. страната излиза от кризата, проучванията за мястото на пресичането на Балкана са завършени и е възможно да започне построяването на най-сложната част от железопътната линия Русе – Подкова. С утвърдения с указ от 31 декември 1897 г. Закон за допълнение на Закона за проектиране и построяване на железопътна мрежа правителството е натоварено от Народното събрание да извърши проучването на Презбалканската линия Търново – Севлиево – Габрово – Шипченския проход – Казанлък. Основни проучвания за пресичане на Балкана са правени и по направленията: Търново – Хаинбоаз – Нова Загора, наричано Централно трасе; Търново – Елена – Сливен (Източно трасе), и споменатото вече направление – през Габрово – Шипченския проход – Казанлък (Западно трасе).

V8wcyIx_8kk.d1: Hello! Today we will travel from Helsinki to Espoo on tram 15. This is a comfortable, high-speed light rail. Helsinki light rail line 15 is a 25-kilometre (16 mi) light rail line connecting Keilaniemi in Espoo and Itäkeskus in Helsinki, Finland. Known during construction as Jokeri light rail , construction was started in June 2019 and the line began operating in October 2023, about 10 months ahead of the original schedule. The line replaced the trunk bus line 550, the busiest bus service on the Helsinki Regional Transport Authority public transport network.

qJnp0_Ik9vQ.d1: After 23 mins ride with dense fog and extremely low visibility, the train finally arrives from Plati R.S. to Veria R.S. (elevation 128 m). The line from Plati to Florina (elevation 687 m) is 159 km long and was opened in 1894 under the name "Société du Chemin de Fer Ottoman Salonique-Monastir", when the area was part of the Ottoman Empire. The Greek government purchased the Greek part of Salonica - Monastir (Bitola) railway in 17 October 1925 and the railway became part of the Hellenic State Railways. The train travels alongside Lake Vegoritida, one of the most beautiful natural lakes in Greece. In this section of the Plati - Florina line there are 16 tunnels and 34 bridges with spans over 4.00m. With OSE Class 621 DMU MAN 2000 (2005).
